info.title: Hodor administration interface
info.description: Users, their sessions and second factors, the audit log, the identity providers, the keys, the applications, the assurance levels, the roles and their permissions, the bindings of resource servers to engines, the policy versions, the record of decisions and the webhooks of a tenant, for the people who run it. Paths are relative to https://{host}/t/{slug}/api/v1/admin. Every operation needs an access token whose user holds a role with the permission named in `x-hodor-permission`.
